title: Feiertage und Schulferien in Thüringen 1991-2029 (öffentlich · katholisch · schulisch — viersprachig)
description: Comprehensive holiday and school-break calendar for the German Bundesland Thüringen (Thuringia, ISO 3166-2 code DE-TH) from 1991 through 2029. Covers all three vacanza-supported categories for Germany: `public` (statutory holidays under the Feiertagsgesetz of Thüringen), `catholic` (supplementary catholic observances not statutorily gazetted), and `school` (Schulferien published by the Kultusministerkonferenz). Names are provided in German (de, native), American English (en_US), Thai (th), and Ukrainian (uk).

meta.title: Feiertage und Schulferien in Thüringen 1991-2029 (öffentlich · katholisch · schulisch — viersprachig) - Kostenloser Download
meta.description: Comprehensive holiday and school-break calendar for the German Bundesland Thüringen (Thuringia, ISO 3166-2 code DE-TH) from 1991 through 2029. Covers all three vacanza-supported categories for Germany: `public` (statutory holidays under the Feiertagsgesetz of Thüringen), `catholic` (supplementary catholic observances not statutorily gazetted), and `school` (Schulferien published by the Kultusministerkonferenz). Names are provided in German (de, native), American English (en_US), Thai (th), and Ukrainian (uk). Enthält 3821 Datensätze. Download in Excel, CSV, PDF.
